items.title: Memory-only Socratic begin seed
evidence: main at 5a876b8eb1 — status/help/version only; no begin command
no active implementation PR; GitHub issue #16 scope must match this spec
acceptance: workframe status remains behaviorally compatible with shipped 0.2.2 read-only discovery and optional minimal test flow
workframe begin performs no network call and reads no provider credential
begin asks one question at a time for human name, entity, purpose, why it matters, success criteria, and constraints
begin prints a bounded memory-only mirror with stated and unresolved provenance; optional --json output
EOF, Ctrl+C, timeout, refusal, and empty answers stop cleanly without orphan work
user text is bounded; control characters removed; answers are not silently reinterpreted
replayable scripted conversation tests on Node 20+ semantics
packed npm bin passes --version, status --json, and scripted begin --json checks

failures: questioning or qualified language could authorize a provider call
authority-boundary tests did not exercise the complete flow
EOF and interruption were not handled deterministically
prompt echo and refusal text could falsely verify providers
best/default questions could select a candidate
verification was not cancellable after consent
account and API-key billing paths were conflated
inference children inherited Docker and SSH authority handles
the implementation branch was behind and diverged from main
no package or repository CI run was attached to the exact reviewed head
descriptive and negative-context candidate mentions can authorize a path
multi-clause exclusions can silently select an unrelated remaining candidate
Windows production taskkill completion and child-tree termination are not observed
exact-head CI is red and does not independently execute the package-local and packed-tarball matrix

archived_inference_regressions.note: When model-assisted inference is implemented, carry these mandatory regressions from the four rejected PRs
required_regressions: descriptive and negative-context candidate mentions remain unresolved
mixed positive and negative clauses select only an explicit affirmative candidate
account-backed and API-key-backed paths stay separate with exact payer disclosure
verification is separately consent-gated and cancellable through terminal, HTTP, and child-process boundaries
inference children receive no Docker, SSH, unrelated credentials, or ambient authority
Windows production taskkill completion and runtime-child-tree exit are observed before cancellation settles
package-local and packed-tarball checks run against the exact review head
exact-head CI must pass Harness verify before acceptance

items.title: Explicit apply and rollback authority gates

invariants: WF-CLI-001 does not modify packages/create-workframe, apps, services, infra, or existing runtime behavior.
WF-CLI-001 does not read, print, persist, or transmit credential values.
Later slices must not overwrite, adopt, or mutate an existing setup without explicit approval of a concrete immutable plan.
Do not use a Workframe-hosted or implicit cloud fallback.
Publication remains a separate reviewed release decision.
Do not merge or rebase origin/automation/wf-cli-001-* branches.
